title: Thinking Machines’ Inkling 2 Small leads as top Western open-source model
digest:
Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Small, claiming it is the strongest Western open-weight model with 17 billion active parameters and $1.18 per task cost (per Artificial Analysis), outperforming its predecessor in output tokens (150,000 average per task vs predecessor) and visual benchmarks (64.7% score). 

However, Inkling 2 Small faces limitations: response rate dropped 53% compared to predecessor, lacks audio support, and requires Tinker platform access. The company stated it plans Apache 2.0 open-sourcing but provided no timeline or technical details yet.

representative.title: Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Small 在西方开源重量模型中占据榜首
representative.summary: Inkling 2 Small 模型在多个基准测试中表现优异，超越前代并接近Gemini 3.8 Flash。其17亿活跃参数下成本$1.18/任务，训练数据量（12万亿令牌）显著少于竞品，视觉理解得分64.7%领先开源模型。但存在响应率下降（53%）、音频不支持等局限，目前通过Tinker平台提供，计划以Apache 2.0开源。
